backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the backend, handling contact form submissions, admin-only submission retrieval with filtering/sorting, and user profile management with role-based access control.
feature_evidence.json: Empty feature evidence report JSON file with no recorded features.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-line summaries of all frontend source files, describing their purpose and Hindi translation status.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS entry file defining CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens (background, foreground, primary, chart colors, sidebar, etc.) using OKLCH values.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the React app titled 'KATTAR SANATANI YODHA', including Google Search Console verification meta tag and mounting the root React component.
frontend/public/ads.txt: Google AdSense ads.txt file declaring a direct relationship with publisher ID pub-4905807488237044.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that sets up TanStack Router with eight routes (home, about, programs, philosophy, resources, contact, donate, admin) under a shared Layout.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Site footer component displaying the logo, Hindi quick links, contact details (email, phone, location), and social media icons for Facebook, X, WhatsApp, and YouTube.
frontend/src/components/Hero.tsx: Full-screen hero section with a background image, Sanskrit tagline, Hindi mission statement, and two CTA buttons for supporting the mission and learning more.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Root layout component that wraps all pages with a Navigation header and Footer, rendering child routes via an Outlet.
frontend/src/components/Mission.tsx: Mission section displaying four core value cards (भक्ति, रक्षा, ज्ञान, एकता) with icons and Hindi descriptions in a responsive grid layout.
frontend/src/components/Navigation.tsx: Responsive navigation bar component with desktop and mobile layouts, active link highlighting, and a conditional admin link shown only to authenticated admin users.
frontend/src/components/ProgramCard.tsx: Reusable card component that displays a program with an icon, title, and description in a styled hover-animated card.
frontend/src/components/SupportOptions.t: Displays a 2x2 grid of support option cards (volunteer, share, skills, knowledge) each with an icon, Hindi text, and a contact link.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using TanStack Query, initializing it with the user's Internet Identity or anonymously, and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useContactForm.ts: Custom hook that manages contact form submission state (submitting, success, error) by calling the backend actor's submitContactForm method.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an InternetIdentityProvider context and useInternetIdentity hook for managing DFINITY Internet Identity authentication, including login, logout, and identity persistence across page reloads.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Exports TanStack Query hooks for fetching all contact submissions, checking if the caller is an admin, and retrieving the current user's profile from the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports Google Fonts, configures a Sanatani-inspired warm (saffron/terracotta) OKLCH color palette for light and dark modes via CSS variables, and defines utility component classes like hero-gradient and text-gradient.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/About.tsx: About page with a hero section, organization story paragraphs in Hindi, and a grid of four principle cards (mission, vision, values, community).
frontend/src/pages/Admin.tsx: Admin dashboard page that displays all contact form submissions in a searchable, filterable table with CSV export functionality, restricted to authenticated admin users via Internet Identity.
frontend/src/pages/Contact.tsx: Contact page with a Hindi-language form (name, email, message) that submits to the backend via useContactForm hook, alongside contact info and social media links.
frontend/src/pages/Donate.tsx: Donation/support page showing support options via SupportOptions component, impact area breakdowns with progress bars, and a transparency commitment section, all in Hindi.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Home page composing Hero and Mission components with a highlights grid (cultural preservation, education, community, service) and a call-to-action section linking to donate and contact pages.
frontend/src/pages/Philosophy.tsx: Philosophy page presenting Sanatan Dharma teachings in Hindi, covering its eternal nature, devotion (bhakti yoga), and exemplary figures like Ram, Hanuman, and Yudhishthira.
frontend/src/pages/Programs.tsx: Programs page listing six initiative cards (Vedic study, cultural festivals, youth education, community gatherings, social welfare, heritage preservation) with impact statistics, rendered in Hindi.
frontend/src/pages/Resources.tsx: React page component displaying a spiritual resources library with four categories (sacred texts, video lectures, articles, downloadable materials) rendered as cards with Hindi text throughout.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility module providing functions to extract URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, persist them in sessionStorage, and clean sensitive params from the URL bar.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with OKLCH-based semantic color tokens, custom saffron/gold palette, serif/display font families, warm box shadows, and accordion/fade-in animations.
project_state.json: Project state tracking file (version 13) recording the goal of translating the app into Hindi, known deployment issues with translations not taking effect, architectural notes, and a list of completed translation feature IDs.
